answer: In an AI-agent economy, Sybil attacks are resisted by requiring every new agent to lock a stake of tokens that increases with the total number of active identities. An attacker must deposit the same growing amount for each fake agent created, so total capital required scales linearly with the number of identities while the opportunity cost of locked funds rises sharply. Honest participants share a single deposit in an expanding garden of verified agents, where the marble-smooth economic barrier withstands a gale of coordinated forgery attempts.
